resolution.quote:
Fixes https://github.com/ros2/rmw_fastrtps/issues/599

Two commits:
  * Copy the implementation done in #468 for dynamic version
  * Add some check to parameters passed to fastrtps_cpp to keep both implementations in sync

notes: Independently verified: issue #599 (ivanpauno, a ROS 2 core maintainer) names the reproducer "RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp ros2 run demo_nodes_cpp listener" and commit 7a191c348554233a9e1eea9295166e86ce094b1b; the log shows failed symbol resolution for all four functions (rmw_subscription_set_on_new_message_callback, rmw_service_set_on_new_request_callback, rmw_client_set_on_new_response_callback, rmw_event_set_callback) in librmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp.so and "Crashes while trying to load the rmw implementation.". rmw_implementation functions.cpp at 31843adc17f28a4af0dc5f160e9e3b4dfb9710ea contains exactly GET_SYMBOL lines 832-835 for the four functions — the consumer resolves them by name at load. PR #468 comment (fetched by id 1106847128) is verbatim. PR #600 "Add EventsExecutor API for dynamic_fastrtps" is MERGED with the quoted description and ci.ros2.org badges. Eligibility: two separately built units (rmw_implementation loader; rmw_fastrtps_dynamic_cpp library); the failure is elements the consumer resolves that the provider never defined — crosses the library boundary; PAIR (not UPGRADE: the provider is not at a newer revision than the consumer was written against; both are contemporaneous master, the provider lags the new API) is the right call, and the spec's reasoning is sound. Class `other` is right — the elements were never present at the provider, so element_removed_or_renamed does not fit. Loudness loud_documented/activate: the loader's own symbol-resolution error at RMW library load time is a load/activation diagnostic from the runtime machinery; "Crashes while trying to load the rmw implementation." confirms the stage. Resolution recommended is right: CI passes but the runs do not identify the rmw_implementation revision, and no one reports the listener working with the fixed library in the thread.
